envelope item count exceeds the two-item test limit
tag content exceeds the four-byte extension limit

undefined byte-string subtype
fast readers reject undefined byte-string subtypes
ordinary bytes require subtype FE
qualified keyword requires a namespace byte length
qualified symbol requires a namespace byte length

namespace length exceeds the remaining payload
